name: EndNote
tagline: Commercial reference manager from Clarivate for saving, organizing and citing references, with optional AI features

evidence.quote: Clarivate Analytics (UK) Limited

vendor_entity.note: Privacy notice names Clarivate Analytics (UK) Limited and Clarivate Analytics (US) LLC as contact entities, and says the Clarivate group is made up of several legal entities. Ultimate parent is Clarivate Plc (see parent_company). The EndNote licence contracting entity is not named on readable pages (licence page blocked: https://endnote.com/license/).

evidence.quote: principal business offices are located at 70 St. Mary Axe, London EC3A 8BE, United Kingdom

vendor_country.note: Headquarters per the 2025 annual report. Privacy notice lists UK and US (Ann Arbor, MI) entity addresses. The 10-K says 7 of 41 leased office locations are in the United States.

evidence.quote: Clarivate Plc is a public limited company incorporated on January 7, 2019 under the laws of Jersey, Channel Islands

parent_company.note: Homepage header reads Clarivate then EndNote, so EndNote sits within the Clarivate group.

eu_representative.note: Vendor group is headquartered in the UK. The privacy notice names UK and US entities and no GDPR Art. 27 representative.
